sanskrit_verse:
आत्मदारार्थलोकानां संचितानां तु गुप्तये ।
नृपतिः कारयेद्दुर्गं प्राकारद्वयसंयुतम् ॥
transliteration:
ātmadārārthalokānāṃ saṃcitānāṃ tu guptaye /
nṛpatiḥ kārayed durgaṃ prākāradvayasaṃyutam //
sph_interpretive_translation: For the protection of the accumulated wealth of self, spouse, purpose, and territory, the sovereign shall establish a fortress enclosed by two walls.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the duty to safeguard accumulated existential assets
Causation arises through conscious structuring of protective infrastructure
Capacity-based responsibility mandates rulers to act preventatively for collective integrity
Restoration logic requires preemptive establishment of secure boundaries
Consciousness alignment is achieved through structural harmony with natural defense
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler_has_accumulated_assets(self, spouse, purpose, territory) AND threat_potential > threshold THEN construct_fortress(two_walls=true)
IF fortress_exists == false AND asset_risk_level == high THEN trigger_sovereign_duty(protocol=construct_defense_structure)
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning national security or existential risk to sovereignty, the Supreme Court must affirm that the State has fulfilled its foundational duty under this verse. The threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable action toward structural preservation aligned with Dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that protection precedes conflict; anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential unfolding from inner stability to outer defense; proportional responsibility aligns with capacity to build; non-punitive reality rule affirms prevention over retaliation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign completion process to ensure protective infrastructure is manifest
Realign administrative capacity to fulfill constitutional duty of safeguarding citizens' existential assets
Restore integrity of territorial consciousness through architectural embodiment of dharma
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all lawful authority. Dharma is restored through conscious fortification. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
